caption: The drawing features a metallic object at the top that resembles a holder or clamp, labeled as "holder" in small, handwritten text. The holder is tubular, silver in color, with a brownish-red, curved, double-ended clamp at one end, and a small, rounded end cap on the opposite side. Below the metallic holder, there are two large, light brown, hand-drawn letter "C" shapes placed side by side, each drawn with a broad, uneven stroke. The composition is set against an off-white background with minimal additional elements. The artist's signature, "Elwanda Simon," is visible to the lower right of the letter "C" shapes.
title: Branding Iron
